Thanks, Irene — attaching procurement intake notes from our side. Our security team will not sign an NDA as a precondition for an exec demo unless the vendor has completed our questionnaire and returned evidence for a couple of controls (data residency/retention, SOC2 status). They will, however, allow an internal technical preview with a solutions engineer to validate integrations.

Procurement contact: Jenna Morales <procurement@northernlabs.com> — she’ll coordinate the questionnaire review. If you can complete and return the questionnaire and send the NDA to procurement@, that would speed things up.

Also, the CTO asked for a short architecture note about how Redwood handles temporary KV cache and what gets written to disk during PBKDF operations — can you point us to a short doc? If not, a high-level bullet list in the reply will do.

Samira

Hi Samira — appreciate the clarity and the procurement contact. Quick plan to keep momentum:

1) We’ll send the DocuSign NDA to procurement@northernlabs.com today (link below) and attach our completed questionnaire; should be back within 24–48 hours in most cases.
2) Let’s run the SE-led technical preview on Thu Feb 17 at 11:00 PT (Irene will present). That keeps your engineers engaged while procurement completes review.
3) As soon as procurement confirms the questionnaire/NDA, we’ll schedule a 45-min executive walkthrough for the week of Feb 21 — we’ll mark tentative holds on the calendars for Feb 22–23.

For the CTO’s ask: short bullets on the disk/cache behavior —
- Short-lived KV cache kept in GPU memory; checkpoints written only for long-running streaming sessions and encrypted at rest using customer KMS when enabled.
- Temporary encrypted swap may touch local SSD for very long sequences (>50k tokens) with strict TTL and automatic purge.
- No persistent PII is stored by default; customer data retention policy is configurable per deployment and enforced via role-based access.

DocuSign NDA: https://redwood.app/docusign/ND-8943
Architecture note (internal): https://drive.google.com/redwood/preview/ND-8943-architecture-notes

If the proposed Feb 17 slot works for you, I’ll send the calendar invite. Otherwise we can move the SE preview to another available slot.

Thanks — Ben
